messages:
Alex H: attaching a quick mock — compact token pane with accordion-style invoice CTA. thoughts? https://img.redwood/mock/token-pane.png

Maria L: I like the compactness but a couple nits: color contrast on the token labels is low, and the invoice CTA feels buried when scoped to project.

Ben T: technically fine. main perf concern is rendering many sparkline rows — we should virtualize. also on mobile the accordion will collapse too aggressively unless we keep a persistent spend summary.

Kim (prod): flagged: default scope should be org for billing admins. if a project-level user lands here we can show a banner: "Viewing project spend". avoids surprise invoice downloads.

Sam - Eng: on the token breakdown numbers — is that pre- or post-cache? we need to be explicit. SDKs expect emitted_token_count but our backend returns billed_tokens after cache. mismatch could confuse customers.

Maria L: agree re: labels. Proposed copy: "Estimated billed tokens (after caching)" with an info tooltip. also the CTA: "Download invoice" vs "Download statement" — invoice implies legal doc so we should gate it behind billing perms.

Alex H: good call. can we try a pattern where the primary CTA is "Export CSV" and secondary is "Invoice (billing only)"? less intimidating for users who just want data.

Ben T: CSV primary is easy. For the invoice button we can show it but disabled with tooltip: "Invoices accessible to billing admins". we have the disable + tooltip pattern already in org settings.

DesignBot: accessibility check: contrast ratio for token percentage chip (#6B6BFF on #FFFFFF) = 3.2:1 — fails AA. Suggested color: #4A47D8 gives 4.8:1.

Maria L: good catch. also history: tiny sparkline + amount is confusing when values jump a lot. can we add micro y-axis ticks or a delta label + sign?

Sam - Eng: delta label OK, but avoid computing heavy aggregates on client. backend can emit last_period_delta as part of the billing summary API.

Alex H: re: layout variants — two options: (A) dense list with inline sparkline + expand for details; (B) card grid with larger visuals. I'm leaning A for large orgs.

Kim (prod): A scales better. B might be friendlier for small teams during marketing demos. Maybe switch based on org size or toggle in the UI.

Ben T: responsive note: for A on narrow viewports, show only top 5 projects and provide "Show more" to avoid long scroll. Virtualization + incremental load solves perf.

Maria L: small copy tweak for the token chip: "tokens billed" -> "billed tokens" (consistency). Also add aria-label to the accordion header: "Expand details for <project name>".

Alex H: quick CSS snippet for the chip we discussed:

```
.token-chip {
  background: #4A47D8;
  color: #fff;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 12px;
}
```

Ben T: looks good. I'll hook up the feature flag: feature_billing_compact_pane. will mock API changes behind flag.

Kim (prod): timeline: can we aim for an internal preview next Thurs? need design review + PM signoff before eng picks it up.

Maria L: I'll iterate the mock with contrast fixes and add the tooltip copy. ping me if you want the Figma link.

Alex H: thanks everyone. action items: Maria update mock + Figma, Ben add feature flag + virtualization spike, Sam add last_period_delta to billing summary API, Kim coordinate preview.

Maria L: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcdef/compact-billing-pane — comments enabled. :eyes:

DesignBot: checklist: contrast fixed ✅, aria-labels noted ✅, billing-perms CTA pattern referenced ✅

Alex H: perfect. I'll schedule the review invite for Thu 2pm. :calendar:
